about.title: About Tacoma Public Schools
about.content: Tacoma Public Schools serves students across Tacoma in Pierce County, Washington. Its conventional student calendar separates the grades 1-12 opening date from kindergarten, marks weekly Wednesday late starts, identifies conference early releases, and reserves dates that may be used to make up weather closures.

about.title: Conventional and Program Calendars
about.content: This page follows the district's conventional student calendar. TPS publishes separate calendars for IDEA, SAMI, and SOTA; Head Start and ECEAP; and ECSE specialized preschool programs, so families in those programs should use the matching official calendar rather than assuming every conventional-calendar date applies.

planningTips.title: Tacoma Public Schools Calendar Notes
content: Grades 1-12 and kindergarten do not begin on the same day. The 2026-2027 calendar also names Transition to Kindergarten with the kindergarten start date.
TPS schedules a one-hour late start every Wednesday during the student year, but the first day for grades 1-12 is specifically marked as having no late start.
Some conference dates are early-release attendance days rather than full no-school days. The affected grade span is stated on the calendar.
Snow make-up dates are conditional. Confirm with TPS before treating one as an attendance day or assuming the scheduled last day has changed.
Program calendars can differ from the conventional student calendar, especially for arts-focused high schools and early-learning programs.

districtFaqs.q: Do Tacoma kindergarten students start on the same day as grades 1-12?
districtFaqs.a: No. TPS lists separate opening dates for grades 1-12 and kindergarten. Check the current school-year calendar for the date that applies to your child.

districtFaqs.q: What does late start mean on the Tacoma Public Schools calendar?
districtFaqs.a: TPS states that schools start one hour late every Wednesday during the student year. Families should confirm exact bell and transportation times with their school.

districtFaqs.q: Are TPS conference dates full no-school days?
districtFaqs.a: Not always. The conventional calendar marks several conference dates as early-release days, including elementary-only and all-grade schedules.

districtFaqs.q: Do IDEA, SAMI, SOTA, and Tacoma preschool programs use this calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Not necessarily. TPS publishes separate calendars for IDEA, SAMI, and SOTA; Head Start and ECEAP; and ECSE specialized preschool programs. Use the program-specific calendar on the official district calendar page.

districtFaqs.q: Can the Tacoma Public Schools last day change?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. TPS lists conditional snow make-up days that may extend or otherwise change the student schedule after a weather closure.
